TRADER PSYCHOLOGY REPORT

Overall Score: 32/100

Trader Type: Momentum Trader

Behavior Analysis: You hold positions across multiple days to capture short-term trends, keeping a positive win rate and risk-reward profile. Your psychological profile indicates high-risk behaviors, including revenge trading, inconsistent sizing, or overtrading.

Top Behavioral Drivers:
1. Profit Factor: Strong risk-to-reward ratios ensure your winners far outweigh your losers.
2. Same Day Trade Ratio: High same-day trading increases transaction frictions and suggests impulse entries.
3. Position Size Variance: Highly inconsistent position sizing creates unpredictable risk exposure.
4. Post-Loss Trade Delay: Impulsive, immediate re-entry after losses leads to rapid capital depletion.
5. Max Loss Streak: Extended losing streaks represent failure to cut losses or stop trading.

Strengths:
✓ Execution Accuracy: Your strategy achieves high entry precision, resulting in more winning than losing trades. (Win Rate: 69.23%)
✓ High Profit Efficiency: Your winning trades generate significantly more profit than your losing trades drain, showing positive skew. (Profit Factor: 10.93)
✓ Post-Loss Risk Control: You do not double down after losing trades, exhibiting professional composure and capital preservation. (Post-Loss size change: 0%)

Weaknesses:
✗ Erratic Position Sizes: Your trade sizes differ widely, exposing your account to unpredictable risk swings. (Size Variance: ₹26,721.2)
✗ Overactive Scalping: You close most trades within the same simulation day, which risks overtrading and higher execution costs. (Same-Day Trade: 88.46%)
✗ Extended Losing Streaks: You hold losing trades or execute bad trades consecutively, amplifying drawdowns. (Loss Streak: 4)

Recommendations:
• Standardize Sizing: Set a fixed exposure target of 3% (₹30,000) per trade. Do not deviate by more than 10% from this amount.
• Extend Holding Periods: Avoid intra-day tick tracking. Practice keeping positions open for at least 2 simulation days.
• Review Market Volatility: Check historical daily candlesticks to identify support and resistance ranges.
• Maintain Sizing Discipline: Do not increase your risk size after a profitable trade out of overconfidence.
